svg.title: Hutan file explorer at 1440×900 — Files panel on the right rail, sections Open Editors, Changed by agents and the tree
svg.desc: Schematic dark-theme window, to scale: titlebar 36, left sidebar 280 (workspaces, projects, worktrees, sessions), center 770 (a file tab over a terminal), right body 350 showing the Files panel next to a 40 px rail (Files selected, Changes with a count badge), status bar 24. Callouts 1-7 are explained in the spike.
svg.text: Left: where work is (projects · worktrees · sessions)
crates › desktop › src › workbench › panels › files.rs
// Files panel: the folder as a tree, read through the daemon
// Git: a changed file gets a letter and a tint
Right: what is in it (Files · Changes · Agents · History)
